title: Choose the /admin shell composition
question: Three structures for Tuned admin. Lock one for the production redesign (Overview tells you what needs you in under 10 seconds).

options.label: Focus Overview
options.thesis: Overview owns the first viewport: Needs you fills the top, metrics wait below; the rail shrinks to icons until you leave Overview.
options.viewport: Left: narrow violet-tinted icon rail. Main: Needs you band with open reports and to-dos first; KPI cards and charts only after you scroll past the triage.
options.risk: Other tabs feel secondary if the collapsed rail is too quiet.

raised.raise: Needs you rows cascade when counts change — amber lamps for snoozed, teal clear for done — without leaving table semantics.
Rail group headers carry committed section hues (Needs you / Numbers / Money / People / Running it), not grey labels.

options.label: Agenda Daybook
options.thesis: Overview reads as today’s agenda: To do and Reports are the primary list; numbers sit as a side ledger you glance at, not the hero.
options.viewport: Full side rail with groups. Main: dated agenda list (report / refund / cron / custom tasks) with Open actions; right column: period KPIs and sparkline deltas.
options.risk: Quiet days look empty unless empty states teach the next check.

options.label: Priority Feed
options.thesis: One vertical scan: numbered priorities (1 Needs you → 2 deltas → 3 charts), same on phone and desk — tables cardify under 768px as today.
options.viewport: Top: wrapping section buttons. Body: step 1 Needs you cards, step 2 period deltas, step 3 charts — no competing columns above the fold.
options.risk: Desktop may feel under-dense until you scroll into charts.
